# Jack's Plastering Northern Beaches

> NSW Fair Trading licensed plastering and gyprocking trade business serving Sydney's Northern Beaches and Sydney-wide. Owner-operator Jack with 15+ years on the tools. Fixed-price written quotes within 24 hours, most jobs completed in a single visit, 2-year written workmanship guarantee. Small plaster hole patches from $290, water-damage ceiling repairs $600–$2,500, full-home plastering $25–$45/m². Call (02) 5500 1608.

Jack's Plastering Northern Beaches is an owner-operator trade business — Jack does the work himself, not a franchise or lead-broker network. Every quote is fixed-price and written; no hourly rates, no deposit until materials arrive on site. All inbound calls are handled 24/7 by an AI receptionist that captures job details and books Jack's diary. Serving the Northern Beaches (Manly, Dee Why, Brookvale, Collaroy, Narrabeen, Mona Vale, Newport, Avalon, Palm Beach) plus Sydney-wide (Lower North Shore, Upper North Shore, Hills district).

Base location: Dee Why, NSW 2099, Australia.

## Pricing

- Small plaster hole patch: from $290 (fixed)
- End-of-lease multi-hole bundle: from $290 (fixed, GST-invoiced for property managers)
- Water-damage ceiling repair: $600–$2,500 depending on ceiling size and repaint scope
- Plaster crack repair: quoted per crack after inspection (structural vs cosmetic split)
- Cornice repair / replacement: quoted per linear metre + profile matching complexity
- Full-home plastering: $25–$45 per square metre
- Emergency callout (sagging ceiling, active leak, collapse risk): 1-hour response target on Northern Beaches; standard quote applies + surcharge for after-hours

## Regulatory Framework

- **NSW Fair Trading licensed** — the peak trade-licensing authority for plastering and gyprocking work in New South Wales. Any tradesperson quoting work over $5,000 is legally required to hold an active NSW Fair Trading contractor licence. Homeowners can verify a plasterer's licence at <https://www.onegov.nsw.gov.au/publicregister/>
- Insurance: works directly with homeowner insurance policies on water-damage and storm-damage claims; provides itemised quotes and photo documentation to insurers on request
- Australian Consumer Law: fixed-price written quotes provided per Section 65 of the ACL; 2-year written workmanship guarantee exceeds the statutory minimum

## Regional Context — Sydney Plastering

- Older Sydney homes (pre-1970 Federation and pre-1990 fibro/gyprock) commonly have lath-and-plaster or asbestos-containing ceiling boards. Any repair on pre-1990 homes should be preceded by a visual assessment for possible ACM presence; Jack refers homeowners to licensed asbestos assessors when suspect materials are visible.
- Northern Beaches coastal salt-air corrosion accelerates ceiling water-damage on properties within ~1 km of the ocean — ceiling repairs in this zone commonly reveal additional metal-fixing corrosion that adds scope.
- End-of-lease demand spikes during quarterly settlement periods (end of March, June, September, December) — book 2 weeks ahead if targeting a specific handover date.
